_about: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check_privacy_manifests.py's source scan.
An entry hides one match from one target's check:
"file": <repo-relative path>, "pattern": <regex over that line>, "reason": <why it needs no declaration>}
Only for a match that is not a use in any build that ships: code compiled solely under a flag no
shipping configuration defines (say which), or text the scanner cannot tell from a call. It already
skips comments, string contents and code another platform's #if excludes. A call a shipped binary
makes is declared in the manifest, never listed here.
An entry that no longer matches anything fails the check, so this list can only shrink.

entries.reason: QA render manifest only: the whole file is inside #if CLIPULSE_QA_RENDER, which only the Debug QA configuration defines (scripts/ci_check_qa_scheme.py pins that); no shipped build compiles it. It records which AppleLanguages the QA render ran with.
